title: הלני והצבעים
subtitle: אדום, צהוב, כחול וירוק

day.heleni: a white long-sleeved top under a soft denim-blue painting smock with a few paint smudges, coral-pink leggings, barefoot.

night.heleni: pale turquoise pajamas with tiny colorful dots.

coverScene: Heleni stands in a bright cozy playroom holding a big paintbrush up in one hand, smiling wide, a little dab of yellow paint on her cheek. Beside her a low table with small pots of red, yellow, blue and green paint and a large blank sheet of paper.

pages.text:
דף לבן וצבעים בשורה,
הלני מציירת, איזו שמחה!
pages.scene: Heleni kneels at a low wooden table with a large blank white sheet of paper and four small pots of paint in a row: red, yellow, blue and green. She dips a big brush into the red pot, excited.

pages.text:
אדום, אדום, תפוח עגול,
הלני מציירת אותו גדול גדול.
pages.scene: Heleni paints a big round red apple shape on the paper with her brush, tongue between her lips in concentration. The red paint pot stands next to her hand.

pages.text:
צהוב, צהוב, שמש חמה,
עם קרניים ארוכות, כמה נעימה!
pages.scene: Heleni paints a big yellow sun with long rays on a sheet of paper, smiling. The simple red apple painting lies beside it on the table. A dab of yellow on her cheek.

pages.text:
כחול, כחול, ים וגלים,
ודג קטן שוחה בין העיגולים.
pages.scene: Heleni paints wavy blue lines like sea waves across a sheet of paper, with one small simple fish shape among round bubbles. She holds the brush in her fist, delighted.

pages.text:
ירוק, ירוק, דשא ועץ,
המכחול קופץ ומתרוצץ.
pages.scene: Heleni paints green grass and a simple round green tree on a sheet of paper with quick happy strokes, her arm lifted, little green dots flying from the brush.

pages.text:
אופס! כתם כחול על האף,
וכתם צהוב על היד, איזה כיף!
pages.scene: Close view from the waist up. Heleni has a blue paint dot on the tip of her nose and yellow paint on her hand. She looks at her painted hand and laughs, eyes crossed a little toward her nose.

pages.text:
יד קטנה טובלת בצבע,
טַפּ על הדף, אחת, שתיים... שבע!
pages.scene: Heleni presses her open paint-covered hand onto a sheet of paper, leaving colorful handprints in red, yellow and blue in a row. She looks proud and amazed.

pages.text:
אדום וצהוב ביחד מתערבבים,
יצא כתום! איזה קסמים.
pages.scene: On a small palette plate, red and yellow paint swirl together into bright orange. Heleni stirs them with her brush and stares at the new orange color with a wide open mouth of wonder.

pages.text:
הציור מוכן, תולים על הקיר,
כל החדר צבעוני ומאיר.
pages.scene: The playroom wall at child height, with several of her simple paintings hanging on a string with small wooden pegs: the red apple, the yellow sun, the blue waves, the green tree and the handprints. Heleni stands in front of them with her arms spread wide, proud.

pages.text:
מים וסבון, ידיים נקיות,
הצבעים הולכים, נשארות בועות.
pages.scene: Heleni stands on a small wooden step stool at a low sink, washing her hands with soap; soft bubbles float up around her and the water in the basin is tinted with gentle swirls of color. She watches a bubble, smiling.

pages.text:
פיג'מה רכה ושמיכה,
הציור על הקיר מחייך אליה בשמחה.
pages.scene: Evening in Heleni's bedroom, warm lamp light. Heleni in her pajamas lies in her small bed under a soft blanket, looking up sleepily at her yellow sun painting, which hangs on the wall above the bed.

pages.text:
לילה טוב, אדום. לילה טוב, כחול.
הלני חולמת חלום צבעוני וגדול.
pages.scene: Night. Heleni is fast asleep in her bed, peaceful face, eyes closed, hugging a small plush bunny. Her paintings hang on the wall above her in the dim light. A soft moon in the window, the room dim dusty blue with a faint warm glow.
